title: Auguries of Innocence (opening)
author: William Blake
lines: To see a World in a Grain of Sand
And a Heaven in a Wild Flower,
Hold Infinity in the palm of your hand
note: 节选（开篇四行）· Public domain. Written c.1803, first published 1863.

title: My Heart Leaps Up
author: William Wordsworth
lines: My heart leaps up when I behold
So was it when my life began;
So is it now I am a man;
So be it when I shall grow old,
The Child is father of the Man;
And I could wish my days to be
Bound each to each by natural piety.
note: Full text · Public domain · Poems, in Two Volumes (1807).

title: The Eagle
author: Alfred, Lord Tennyson
lines: He clasps the crag with crooked hands;
Close to the sun in lonely lands,
Ring'd with the azure world, he stands.
The wrinkled sea beneath him crawls;
He watches from his mountain walls,
And like a thunderbolt he falls.
note: Full text · Public domain. Published 1851; Tennyson died in 1892.

title: Aku

lines: Dan aku akan lebih tidak perduli
